title: Private Dance lesson with an Off Broadway NYC Pro
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Located near the Grand Ole Opry! Learn the top line dances being danced in Nashville! Private lesson to go over all steps, songs, dances, correct form and technique as well as posture. Learn from a professionally trained dancer and performer from NY. All styles taught. 
Good for anyone! You can take videos of the class when done to practice. The lesson will get you ready to go out at night to practice your moves.
